recipe.title: Greek yogurt tuna salad
steps: Drain the tuna and flake it in a bowl.
Mix in the yogurt, mustard, the zest of the lemon and a squeeze of its juice.
Wash and tear the lettuce. Slice the cucumber.
Pack the tuna mix, lettuce, cucumber and bread in separate containers.
Serve the tuna on the lettuce with the cucumber and bread on the side.
